description: garmin_get_day over a date range, one compact row per day, for "am I absorbing this training?" and other recovery-vs-load questions: resting heart rate, HRV and its status, sleep duration and score, Body Battery, stress, intensity minutes, steps, and that day's activity count, duration, distance and training load. `summary` has average / min / max per field. Defaults to the last 7 days; at most 31 days per call. For one field in more detail use garmin_get_daily_summaries, garmin_get_sleep_summaries, garmin_get_hrv_summaries or garmin_search_activities.

end_date.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today, or 6 days after start_date (not past today).

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone. Default: 6 days before end_date. At most 31 days per call.

name: garmin_get_days
title: Get Garmin days
